## Highlights
### Improved
- On Mac, a new Quick Window opens at the size you last gave one, even after restarting Crest.
### Fixed
- On Mac, a Quick Window goes on remembering the size you give it after its contents change. - When a browser import during setup can’t save some passwords, its summary says how many. Importing a password file in Settings says whether the Space’s passwords or the file couldn’t be read, and no longer says your passwords were restored when nothing had changed.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
